basic_details.organization_name: CSIR National Enviromental Engineering Research Institute
basic_details.short_information: The CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI) has officially announced the Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening under Advertisement No. RECRUIT_SD_2A_WESD_23072026_A. Candidates who are up to 35 years of age and hold an M.E./ M.Tech. in Civil, Chemical, Environmental, or Energy Engineering from a recognized University can submit their online applications on or before 30-07-2026. Direct links to download the official notification and apply online are shared below.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate-II position at CSIR NEERI is 30th July 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Associate-II position, candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech. degree in Civil, Chemical, Environmental, or Energy Engineering from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, though not explicitly detailed here.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 35,000, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA). The exact amount may depend on NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate-II position announced in this recruitment drive by CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II position at CSIR NEERI will involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature. This means the position is for a fixed term, and the employment is not permanent.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Maharashtra, with the specific city mentioned as Mumbai for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of CSIR NEERI or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section. Ensure you complete the application before the last date.
